h2: Find Your Way to Speak Up
items: A History of the Vegan Movement

links.text: Humane education Helping people, often students, think through how their choices affect animals, people and the planet.
Street outreach Conversations with people on the street, often with footage, so they can see for themselves. OPEN NOW
Direct action Protests, vigils and peaceful public actions that bring attention to what animals go through. OPEN NOW
Legal and policy work Changing laws, rules and the way companies and schools do things. OPEN NOW
Sanctuaries and rescue Giving animals a safe home for life, and showing visitors who they really are. OPEN NOW
Talks That Changed Minds Philip Wollen, Joey Carbstrong, Earthling Ed, James Aspey, James Wildman and Gary Yourofsky. OP
A History of the Vegan Movement A timeline from the earliest records to today, one era at a time. OPEN NOW
